plan: [In this sealed-bid second-price auction with independent private values, bidding your true value is a weakly dominant strategy. My private value is $25. Rational opponents will likely bid their values, so bidding $25 maximizes expected profit and prevents overpaying. I will bid my true value of $25.]

[This is a second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values. Truth-telling (bid = value) is a weakly dominant strategy: it maximizes expected payoff regardless of opponents' strategies. Other bidders are rational. Bidding my true value $17 avoids underbidding (losing positive surplus) or overbidding (risking losses).]

[This is a sealed-bid second-price auction. Bidding my true value is a dominant strategy: it maximizes expected surplus because if I win I pay the second-highest bid, never more than my value. Opponents are rational and values are independent, so I will bid my private value $39. Tie randomness does not change this incentive.]
